title: Servicing of the Vacuum Toilet Assembly and the Flush Interface
abstract: Scheduled servicing of a vacuum toilet assembly: rinse ring descaling, flush valve seat check and the vacuum decay test that confirms the bowl seals before the aircraft returns to service.

sections.purpose: This task gives the scheduled servicing of one vacuum toilet assembly, including descaling of the rinse ring and the vacuum decay test of the bowl seal.
sections.job_setup_note: The waste tank must be drained and flushed at the ground servicing panel before any work starts in the lavatory. Wear the protective equipment listed in the standard practice for waste system work. The descaling agent is aggressive and must not be left in contact with the bowl beyond its stated dwell time. Have the vacuum decay test set ready before the bowl is reassembled, because a failed seal is much easier to correct with the assembly still open.
sections.procedure: 1. Drain and flush the waste tank at the ground servicing panel. 2. Put the warning notices in position at the lavatory door in zone 914 or zone 933 as applicable. WARNING: WEAR THE PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT GIVEN IN THE STANDARD PRACTICE. WASTE SYSTEM CONTENTS ARE A BIOLOGICAL HAZARD. 3. Isolate the flush control at the cabin panel. 4. Remove the shroud and get access to the flush valve and the rinse ring. 5. Apply the descaling agent to the rinse ring and let it dwell for the stated time. CAUTION: DO NOT LEAVE THE DESCALING AGENT ON THE BOWL BEYOND THE DWELL TIME. THE BOWL SURFACE WILL BE ETCHED AND WILL THEN SCALE FASTER. 6. Rinse the ring and check that every jet is clear. 7. Do a detailed visual inspection of the flush valve seat and replace the seal if it is marked. 8. Check the monument fitting 416WP and the latch 41WM for security. 9. Renew the washers EN887884-5C at any joint that has been opened. 10. Check the lining 44WP3 for staining that would indicate a past leak. 11. Reassemble the shroud and restore the flush control. 12. Do the vacuum decay test on the bowl and compare the decay rate with the limit.
sections.close_out: Record the descaling, the flush valve seat condition and the vacuum decay rate on the aircraft work card. Do three flush cycles and confirm normal operation. Remove the warning notices and restore the lavatory to service. Report a decay rate that is inside the limit but worse than the previous visit, because the seal is then approaching replacement.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The decay rate limit in step 12 applies to the standard bowl seal; aircraft with the reinforced seal use the second column of the acceptance table.

safety_precautions: Wear the protective equipment for waste system work.
Drain and flush the waste tank before starting.
Do not exceed the descaling agent dwell time.
